description: This bar chart, titled “Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2)”, illustrates the accuracy scores for four different language models—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—across four distinct attribute categories: “hobby” (teal), “university” (orange), “major” (pink), and “birthdate” (green). The horizontal axis lists the four models, while the vertical axis represents accuracy, scaled linearly from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each model is represented by a group of four adjacent bars, one for each attribute, allowing for direct comparison of performance across attributes for each model. For the Qwen2.5-7b-1M model, the “hobby” accuracy is approximately 90, “university” is around 90, “major” is approximately 95, and “birthdate” is about 90. For Internlm3-8b, “hobby” accuracy is around 70, “university” is approximately 75, “major” is about 65, and “birthdate” is approximately 90. For ProLong-8b, “hobby” accuracy is approximately 70, “university” is around 80, “major” is about 30, and “birthdate” is approximately 90. For the Qwen2.5-7b model, “hobby” accuracy is approximately 2, “university” is around 3, “major” is about 3, and “birthdate” is approximately 15. The bars are not sorted by value; instead, they are presented in the order of the model names from left to right. The “birthdate” attribute consistently shows the highest accuracy across all models, while the “major” attribute for ProLong-8b is notably lower than the others, and the Qwen2.5-7b model shows the lowest accuracy across all attributes.
